cause: The fixed approximately 1.1 second cancellation assertion ran before Windows Microsoft IME completed its native prediction/TranslateMessage wait. Without further input, the queued cancellation and Escape notifications arrived and the existing normalizer removed the preedit. The diagnostic run remains failed; its result was not rewritten to passed.
fix: After exactly two Escape presses, poll the real UIA search value until empty with a bounded 10 second deadline before refocusing or sending the next conversion. Record the initial sample and wait duration. Keep all eight cancellation/conversion checks.
